title: [Shopify] Limit webhook subscription payload fields
summary: Shopify webhook subscriptions now request only the required fields (id for orders, admin_graphql_api_id and type for bulk operations) instead of receiving full webhook resources, reducing payload size and network overhead.
key_points: Webhook subscriptions are now created with topic-specific includeFields
ORDERS_CREATE webhooks request only the id field
BULK_OPERATIONS_FINISH webhooks request only admin_graphql_api_id and type
Existing subscriptions are not changed; the reduced payload applies to new or recreated ones
No schema, permission, or upgrade changes
